title: SystemAuditEntry
description: One row in the tamper-evident system audit log. Each entry carries the SHA-256 of the previous row; a monthly dump is cosign-signed to R2 Object Lock with 7-year retention. Contract anchor: PRODUCTION_READINESS.md v1.0 §3.

sequence.description: Monotonically increasing serial. Gaps are a red flag.

details.description: Free-form JSON for action-specific context. Must NEVER contain secrets, raw LLM keys, or PII beyond what's needed to interpret the event.

requestId.description: W3C traceparent request id to correlate with Grafana Tempo spans.

ip.description: Originating IP. Truncated to /24 (IPv4) or /64 (IPv6) for EU residents unless retention exception applies.

prevHash.description: SHA-256 of the previous row's canonical JSON. The first row uses '0000...0000' (64 zeros).

rowHash.description: SHA-256 of this row's canonical JSON excluding rowHash itself. Verification job recomputes and alerts on mismatch.

id.description: Stable identifier for the actor. null for 'system' entries (e.g. scheduled jobs).
